evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: NOT PRESENT — rep launches into logistics probing immediately without time-boxing or promising a dependable quote
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Moving day not explicitly confirmed; route (Gold, TX to Dallas storage) and city-to-city mentioned by customer; approximate size inferred from walkthrough but not asked upfront as discovery
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked AFTER probing: 'other than that, do you have any other, like, specific concerns or what are you most worried about for the upcoming move?' — only near end of logistics walkthrough
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises piano weight/model concern; rep asks 'Do you know the model or the maker?' and then resolves it without deeper follow-up on the underlying anxiety. No two-layer pattern.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: NOT PRESENT — no summary reflection of concerns heard
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house), rooms, items, special considerations (piano, washer/dryer staying, appliances staying), parking, and outdoor items all covered extensively via virtual walkthrough
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: 'do you need help packing, packing service? Yes, yes, sir.' — asked and confirmed
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'typically for a house the size we would see around fifty to seventy boxes worth of items... what do you think is a good ballpark number?' — asked
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: No range, no personalization — rep says 'I'll create the estimate and then send it to you via email' without anchoring price or typical cost for this move profile
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial — rep mentions 'travel fee, the overnight fee and the hourly rate and then how much it would be for the pack and portion' but no 'not a guess' framing, no 2.5-hour minimum, no 15-minute-increment language
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: NOT ASKED — no price-acceptance check at all
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No loop-closing question about the Two Promises
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: NOT ASKED — rep says 'unless you have anything else you wanna discuss before we end the call' (throwaway phrasing) rather than genuine concern re-check
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: 'Anything outside or maybe have a grill push' — partial catch-all for outdoor items; later 'unless you have anything else you wanna discuss' — both are present but final genuine concerns check is missing
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: NOT ASKED — rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Call ends with 'I'll email you the estimate' with no booking ask
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: NONE — no date, phone, arrival window, crew size, or address confirmation collected. Rep only promises to email estimate in 5–10 minutes

top_strength: Rep conducted a thorough, room-by-room virtual walkthrough and gathered comprehensive inventory details with good follow-up on special items like the piano, ensuring the estimate will be accurate.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire sales framework — no quid pro quo open, no genuine agenda check, no pricing discussion, no Two Promises, and crucially no ask for the business. Rep gathered discovery well but never moved it toward a close; treat this as a discovery call and re-train on Sections 1, 4, 5, and 7 flow.
